angular_coverage.academic_clarification: The camera centers sweep an azimuth span of 357.63° around the scene centroid, and viewing orientations rotate through 59.97° from keyframe 00 to 31. Claims of a full ~200° orbit represent cumulative motion path arc length, not a single static subtended azimuth.

registration_break_diagnostics.rejection_cause_frame_32: Frame 32 had 21 2D-3D matches with only 14 PnP RANSAC inliers (threshold >= 15). Laplacian blur variance dropped significantly during fast camera panning, causing sub-pixel feature centroid degradation.
registration_break_diagnostics.recovery_strategy_without_lowering_thres: Rather than dangerously relaxing the PnP inlier floor below 15 (which induces trajectory drift), recovery can be achieved through: (1) bidirectional track chaining matching frame 32 against earlier non-adjacent frames via global loop closure / wider matching windows, (2) CLAHE local contrast enhancement on blurred frames to elevate SIFT keypoint detection in low-contrast regions, or (3) registering remaining frames (33-46) as a separate independent sub-map and merging via 3D-3D Sim(3) alignment.
